landmarkFeedback.acceptanceRule: apply on a better worst gate margin, a strict Pareto improvement, or a >=0.01 sparse-hybrid gain with every required regression bounded to 0.005

headFeedback.acceptanceRule: bounded radial candidates; apply only when the worst required gate margin improves

reference.source: Amazon Berkeley Objects CC-BY-4.0 ground-truth GLB

audit.limitation: Uniform translation, scale, and bounded yaw are removed only for shape distance; raw axis dimensions remain an independent blocking gate. Surface sampling does not prove semantic part identity, hidden interfaces, or material fidelity.
Texture signals are bound to actual embedded encoded payload bytes and prove delivered spatial variation and provenance, not calibrated physical BRDF parameters.

pbrReferenceAudit.evidenceRule: A spatial PBR channel in the trusted reference requires delivered variation and reference/measured provenance bound to the locked ground-truth or input-image SHA-256 set.
